observation: Round 2 (stage 1 frozen at the anchor draw, full=false; oblique/horizontal Hough relaxed to 30/30 with gaps 75/20; pattern_tolerance 18; segment_width 1975) is the best round so far: proxy 0.520 (anchor) -> 0.541, still in the refine band. The entire gain came from correspondence_f1@15 (0.191 -> 0.229); sam_fill_rate (0.7170697...) and depth_nan_ratio (0.2452039...) are bit-identical to the anchor, and ring_count stayed 10/10 with recentre_residual_max_cm 23.2. Two GT-blind conclusions follow. (a) On this frozen checkpoint the SAM geometry knobs are not the lever: segment_width 1800 -> 1975 changed fill_rate by exactly zero, so coverage is set by the depth holes (NaN 0.245), not by template width; the only proxy feature that moved between rounds is correspondence, which is driven by how many label boundaries are backed by detected joint lines. (b) The round-2 geometry premise was wrong for the frozen map: the anchor depth map is 3631 x 4711 px, so the 10 synthetic ring cells (verticals at x ~180, 545, 908, 1271, 1634, 1997, 2360, 2723, 3086, 3449) are 363 px = 1815 mm wide, essentially the T4 prior 1800 mm; the 1978 mm / 395 px figure came from the round-1 re-rolled map (3956 px wide), which is no longer in play. A 395 px template on 363 px cells overlaps each neighbour by ~32 px. Anchor detection artifacts on the frozen map: only ~16 oblique segments (9 positive, 7 negative), ~15 short horizontals, concentrated in the upper-middle band (y 1200-2000) and around y ~2950-3000 / 3450; prompts are 4 'assume' (y ~1120 and ~1550 at x 180/545/1634/3449), 4 'midpoint', 1 positive_slope, 1 negative_slope (det_real_detection_ratio 0.6). In the SC overlay the large majority of label boundaries are red (unsupported) and most joint lines are orange (not explained), while the outlier map itself shows long dotted block joints (e.g. y ~1750-1800 for x 1800-2700; y ~2950-3000 for x 700-3300) and dotted ring joints (x ~1450, 1800, 2170, 2530, 2900) that are broken into short runs below the current vote/gap thresholds. The theta-scale distortion from the 23 cm off-centre residual is up to atan(0.23/3.75) ~ 3.5 deg ~ 46 px of the 4711 px circumference at the worst theta, so K/AB distance-pattern checks at 18 px tolerance still reject genuine intersections near the map ends. Circumference check: K 245 px + 6 x 745 px = 4715 px vs 4711 px map height, so the K/AB pixel priors themselves are correct and should not be changed. The two full-width white bands at y ~1000-1150 and ~2200-2500 are ~97 deg apart, not 180 deg, so they are physical (tube / bracket) gaps rather than off-centre band loss; NaN 0.245 is only slightly above the 19-22% complex-family norm and is not addressable via the denoise band without leaking structure.
rule: experiences.md section 10 / section 12: keep stage 1 frozen and replay stages 2-6 when comparing overlays; the anchor draw (23.2 cm) beats the round-1 re-roll (35.6 cm) and no bounded unfolding knob implements residual_recentre, so no 'unfolding' key and full=false. Section 9: the proxy is a directional signal; the between-round delta (+0.02 from correspondence alone, coherence features flat) points at stage 4, not stage 5. Section 3/4: do not widen mask_r to hide an off-centre centreline or structural voids; keep T4 priors 3.65/3.90. sam4tun_ontology d7 (m_line_yield low AND horizontal fallback triggered -> f_missing_lines) -> r_relax_hough: 'lower p_hough_oblique threshold or raise maxLineGap toward tunnel prior', precondition satisfied because the upstream causes (f_depth_holes from the off-centre draw, joint enhancement thresholds) are known and not in bounds. d8/r_fix_height_priors: keep K_height_pixel/AB_height_pixel (they reproduce the 4711 px circumference) and adjust only p_pattern_tolerance for the measured theta distortion. Section 5: keep hough_threshold_vertical 5000 so the 10 synthetic ring-centre verticals stay locked to ring_count (10 = 10; never regress to 11). r_fix_template: segment_width should equal the actual segment width of the map being segmented (363 px = 1815 mm on the frozen anchor map), not the width measured on a different centreline draw. Section 8: on 4-3 expect gains from detection-pattern parameters, not from orientation or SAM sweeps.
failure_mode: stage_1_centreline.f_curve_overfit remains active but is confirmed unfixable within bounds (round 1) -> frozen. Primary addressable mode on the frozen map: stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines (d7: low oblique yield, 40% 'assume' prompts, most label boundaries unsupported -> low correspondence_f1@15) with a secondary stage_4_detection.f_pattern_mismatch component (d8: off-centre theta distortion up to ~46 px vs 18 px tolerance rejects genuine intersections near the map ends). Stage 5: a mild stage_5_segmentation.f_template_mismatch introduced in round 2 (1975 mm template on 1815 mm cells) — harmless to fill_rate but geometrically wrong; corrected rather than tuned.
rationale: Round 3 is the last round, so it continues the one direction that measurably raised the proxy and undoes the one premise that was wrong, keeping every other knob fixed so the delta stays attributable. Stage 1: omitted (full=false), replay on the frozen anchor checkpoint (residual 23.2 cm, depth_nan_ratio 0.245 preserved). Denoising: T4 prior 3.65/3.90 unchanged (no band widening; the white bands are structural). Enhancing: curvature_threshold 0.0005 unchanged (surface up-sampling only; it does not sharpen joints). Detection: hough_threshold_vertical 5000 and binary_threshold 127 unchanged (ring count lock; binarisation not shown to be live on the outlier map). Move the oblique Hough to the low end of the band, threshold 30 -> 25 with maxLineGap_oblique 75 -> 80, so the long dotted block joints visible in the outlier map (currently broken into sub-threshold runs) accumulate into lines within the [5,10] deg filter — round 2 showed this direction converts 'assume' prompts into real ones and raised correspondence by +0.04. Move the horizontal Hough to threshold 25 with maxLineGap_horizontal 20 -> 25 so the near-horizontal joints around y ~2950-3000 and ~3450 (already partially caught as blue segments) are caught along their full length and provide 'midpoint' prompts instead of 'assume'. Raise pattern_tolerance 18 -> 20 (band top) because the off-centre draw distorts the theta scale by up to ~46 px at the worst theta, so genuine K/AB intersections near the map ends fail the distance-pattern check at 18 px; the fixed synthetic verticals plus merge_close_points bound the spurious-intersection risk. SAM: segment_width 1975 -> 1815 mm (= 363 px, the actual ring-cell width on the 3631 px frozen anchor map; T4 prior is 1800) so templates tile the cells exactly instead of overlapping neighbours by ~32 px; K_height 1226.97 and angle 9.8 stay at T4 priors (the K/AB pixel priors reproduce the 4711 px circumference; no GT-blind evidence of a block-height or taper mismatch). Expected GT-blind effects: more oblique/horizontal lines that are explained by boundaries (cyan) in the SC overlay, det_real_detection_ratio >= 0.7 (<= 3 'assume' prompts), correspondence_f1@15 above 0.229, ring_count 10, depth_nan_ratio 0.245 and sam_fill_rate ~0.717 unchanged (the proxy gain must come from correspondence), proxy above the round-2 0.541 and staying in the refine band. Risk: at the band floor the oblique Hough may add spurious lines from bracket/void edges (f_spurious_lines); ring count is locked by the synthetic verticals and prompts are still gated by the K/AB pattern, so the downside is bounded to a few misplaced prompts; if correspondence falls below 0.229 the round-2 overlay remains the selection candidate.
